messages:
Maya: Quick sync postmortem follow-up for the token-introspect regression. Need owners for: token rotation, permissions cleanup, audit-log gaps, and recurring checks. Keep replies short so we can put owners in the doc.
Tom R.: I can own token rotation. Proposal: critical tokens first (deployers, scheduler). Critical rotation in 48h, full sweep in 7 days. I'll open SEC-900.
Ivy: I'll take perms cleanup. Plan: snapshot IAM + k8s rolebindings, diff vs baseline, and submit remediation PRs. ETA 5 business days.
Ken (infra): For audit gaps I'll check forwarder filters + consumer lag. I'll enable temporary sampling for 36h and add a 12h alert on log-backlog.
sec-bot: Created SEC-900: "token-introspect follow-up" assigned to Tom R. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-900
Maya: Add a tiny validation runbook to SEC-900 so oncall can verify after rotation. Example check: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $NEW\" https://auth.internal/v1/introspect | jq .active` -> expect true; old token -> 401/false.
Tom R.: Will add runbook and a short smoke (staging) before prod rotate.
Ivy: Commands I'll run: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > iam.json` and `kubectl get rolebindings --all-namespaces -o json`. Will post diff to ENG-4200.
Ken (infra): Note: sampling on for 36h may increase disk/network. I'll add autoscale rules on shipper nodes and a 24h alert if disk > 75%.
Maya: Recurring checks proposal: weekly token smoke, monthly perms diff, daily audit-ingest healthcheck. Who can own the weekly smoke?
Tom R.: I'll wire the weekly smoke into /ops/health and post pass/fail.
Maya: Action summary: Tom -> SEC-900 rotation + weekly smoke (48h), Ivy -> perms diff + PR (5d), Ken -> logs sampling + infra alerts (now). Review meeting in 3 business days.
ops-bot: Reminder: review SEC-900 in 3 business days. Attendees: Maya, Tom R., Ivy, Ken.
